result.title: LLM-coupled interpretable tool wear monitoring with multi-evidence reasoning in CNC machining
result.summary: Interpretable tool wear assessment in CNC machining is challenging. Existing diagnostic models have high accuracy but provide limited guidance for tool replacement. This study proposes a two layer framework combining deep learning wear classification and LLM assisted reasoning. The first layer uses PCA Loading feature selection and optimized GRU to recognize three wear states, achieving 98.38 percent macro F1 score on the PHM2010 dataset. The second layer uses LLMs to generate natural language reports and replacement suggestions from classification results and feature trends. Engineer evaluation shows the reports outperform rule templates. Cross dataset tests on NASA milling data support the generalizability of this framework.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出两层框架：先用 PCA 特征选择与优化 GRU 对数控加工刀具磨损做三态分类，再用 LLM 依据分类结果与特征趋势生成自然语言报告和换刀建议。
